_comment: apps/ReferenceData (docs/reference_data_PRD.md §4.16). Administrators sign in with a local password and hold the
reference-data library's slot: its read-only admin pages (places, postal codes, streets, countries, lineage, import
runs) and the Import now action. Signed-in users manage the consumer page's venues. Nothing is granted anonymously:
the public reference-data contract is /api/v1 (anonymous by design, CORS-open, rate-limited), never /spark.
